items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ron said, “What the heck’s he playing? I don’t know this song.” ... [INTERVIEWER] If you and Ron don’t know it, it’s got to be a pretty obscure song.

ctx.x: Ron said, “What the heck’s he playing? I don’t know this song.”
That’s right. He played a tune that neither of you had ever played.
